mapper.select: SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.class_subject, cd.memo, cd.teaching_unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM classes c LEFT JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id WHERE c.class_id = #{id}

SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.class_subject, cd.memo, cd.teaching_unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM classes c LEFT JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN calendar_cells cc ON cc.calendar_cell_id = c.calendar_cell_id WHERE cc.class_at = #{date}
mapper.update: UPDATE classes SET class_name VALUES (#{name}) WHERE class_id = #{id}
